title: Clo Summit New York 2025 🗽
description:
Enjoy the highlights from the CLO Summit New York this year - our biggest US event to date! This year's theme was "Blueprint for Success", focusing on practical strategies for 3D adoption. We were thrilled to welcome over 300 industry professionals and see many familiar faces. 
Thank you to everyone who attended - we look forward to seeing you next year!
transcript: It's the one time a year that our team really hunkers down and gets a lot of stuff done together. They pull all-nighters, it kind of feels like going back to college again. And then we release this great product to create a community with all of our users and it's just such a great feeling to see everyone here and the energy is really high. I've been at my company for about a year and we just started implementing processes. So to hear from people who have been in it for five to seven years who have actually gone through this, it's really helpful for us to say, okay maybe we should do that, maybe we should try this. We love hearing feedback and thoughts directly from users. We also like hearing what they really liked and also what they want improved. Seeing how everybody's using the software really quickly and easily from everyone and just getting like a lot of opinions at once. My favorite thing about this summit is that we get to see all of our clients recognize each other from last year and kind of trade tricks and tools that they've learned over the years. There's so much excitement with all of like the new features within Clo. So definitely diving into it like once we get back, figuring out how can we apply this to our current workflow and learning from there. We're super excited. There was so much great content today. How can we improve our processes inside our brands? We live in a huge bubble of enterprises and fashion business. We don't actually look around that much. So being here, sharing with Nike, talking with Ibram Kroby, chatting with the Hugo Boss, VP of supply chains, really helped me visualize how big can this be. How big can we go with 3D technology, with DPC, inside Pharma and other brands and actually opened my eyes to we need to fast-track our development. Clo has so much more potential than we realize and the foundations we lay today we can't even imagine yet where it can go in the future and I think there's more than what we're currently seeing. Clo really cares about their users opinions and that you are open for our feedback and I feel like that's what we're going for. I love the company, I believe in Clow, and I think it's definitely the future.
